SELECT census_original.dv_cmdline_args, census_original.dv_create_time FROM census_original  WHERE census_original.dv_version = 'sample' AND census_original.dv_create_time = 'NULL' AND census_original.dv_cmdline_args LIKE 'sample' ORDER BY census_original.dv_create_time LIMIT 100;
